notes:
Summary: Mid-market analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood. Started with Hosted API POC for embeddings + chat; moving to Dedicated with VPC for production.
- POC takeaways: embeddings quality good, token cost higher than expected on bursty workloads. Latency targets: tail <200ms for chat, <150ms for embeddings at 95th pct. Throughput: 500-1,200 QPS for search peak windows (daily spikes).
- Primary drivers for Dedicated: data isolation (customer PII), KMS-managed keys, predictable throughput at peak, strict retention and audit requirements.
- Security asks (from security lead Clara M.): need SOC2 Type II evidence, SSO/SAML integration guide + sample metadata, audit log export cadence, log retention configurable to 7+ years, and explicit data residency assurances for EU customers. "We can't have customer IDs leaving EU without explicit consent" (paraphrase).
- Technical notes from SE call (Jordan): prefer model routing with fallback to cheaper quantized variant; want prefix caching for repeated chat context; require sticky routing for session affinity. VPC peering questions: overlapping CIDR with existing infra; asked for example peering diagram and route tables.
- Pricing: AtlasQuery expects a committed monthly invoice for Dedicated (50-100k GPU-hours/year equivalent). They've asked for a TCO comparison (hosted vs dedicated) with unit economics per 1M tokens and per-embedding call.
- Stakeholders: CTO (Victor Hale) - decision maker for infra and compliance; Head of Product (Maya Alvarez) - cares about latency and quality; Security Lead (Clara M.) - controls go/no-go for Dedicated.
- Quote snippets: "If we can get KMS + VPC peering and SOC2 in place, we'll push to procurement in April." — Victor H.
- Next steps (short): share SOC2 package + dedicated network diagram by 2026-03-12, follow up with SSO test metadata, price commit scenarios (6/12/24mo). SE to produce a runbook for KMS integration.
- Blockers: SOC2 docs not yet provided; KMS key wrapping flow needs confirmation; internal budget cycle Q2; CIDR overlap blocking peering.
- Artifacts: demo recording (fireflies ff_2026-02-10_AtlasQuery-demo-01), pricing draft on Drive, security review notes on Drive, Jira ticket RDWSUP-1123 tracking KMS questions.
